responsibility: Declares the public backend entry points exported by the Xstormy16 target implementation for use from headers, generated machine-description code, and other target macros. The prototypes cover stack frame layout and prologue/epilogue expansion, branch and switch expansion/output helpers, call and move/arithmetic expanders, addressing and reload helpers, trampoline and assembler-output routines, and predicates/helpers shared between stormy16.cc and the machine description files.
